visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing a blue and white vertical-striped shirt over a white t-shirt, sits indoors against a grey sofa. Behind him are white horizontal blinds and a black hat hanging on a wooden pegboard. He waves his right hand playfully toward the camera with a wide smile and squinted eyes. (2) He holds a small, reflective silver cylindrical bottle with a clear pump top and a blue label featuring white text. He points his index finger at the bottle and then at his right cheek, maintaining an enthusiastic facial expression with raised eyebrows and an open mouth. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the silver bottle held against a plain white background under bright, flat studio lighting. The person's hand is visible holding the lower part of the bottle, rotating it slightly to catch the light. (4) The man appears in a split-screen comparison; the top frame shows a close-up of his cheek with a circular red patch of skin, while the bottom frame shows the same area with smooth, clear skin. He touches his face with one finger in the lower frame. (5) He pumps a drop of clear, viscous liquid onto the back of his left hand and uses his right index finger to spread it in a circular motion. The camera remains in a close-up view of his hands against his striped shirt. (6) A graphic overlay appears with blue, white, and pink text, showing images of multiple skincare bottles and a blue pouch. The background is a mix of white and light blue with promotional numbers. (7) The man sits in front of a large mirror with light bulbs on its frame. Several blue and silver skincare products are lined up on the counter. He gestures with both hands, forming an 'X' with his fingers and then opening them wide while speaking excitedly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music with a steady 128 BPM synthesizer beat begins. A male voice starts narrating immediately with an animated and high-pitched variability tone. The vocal delivery is rapid and highly enunciated, typical of social media marketing. (2) A distinctive digital 'pop' sound effect triggers alongside a visual graphic change. The narrator continues talking about product features without pause, while the background music maintains its consistent rhythmic drive and bright spectral profile. (3) A brief sound of female laughter is heard in the background at a lower volume, creating a conversational and social atmosphere. The male narrator's speech exhibits rising intonations to emphasize promotional points, while a 'whoosh' transition effect plays. (4) Multiple 'ping' and 'ding' sound effects occur in rapid succession, marking the appearance of different text callouts on the screen. The music remains balanced in the mix, providing energetic support without masking the primary vocal signal. (5) The narration reaches a peak in speed and arousal while detailing a specific 11/11 sale offer. Short UI click sounds punctuate the end of various phrases, and the music swells slightly before fading as the speech concludes with a final chime.
